The fake provider only answers when the request carries header X-Subscription-Token equal to the brave-search-key fixture value, which proves the Credential Broker resolved the placeholder inside the connector. The value itself must never appear in any file, transcript, tool result or artifact.
matching: case-insensitive; a query matches an entry when it contains every token of `match`; otherwise `fallback` is returned
